name: Craftsman's Writ: Potion of Demonslaying
summary: A transferable writ asks for a Potion of Demonslaying. It also gives information about delivery and payment.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The faded note requests one Potion of Demonslaying and provides information about where to deliver it and how payment is handled. You need the writ with you to complete the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Potion of Demonslaying.
The delivery location is marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ with me?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ with you to complete the transaction.
